welcome.title: Welcome to Mastermind
welcome.intro: Crack the secret code before you run out of guesses.

rules.code: The code has {{pegs}} pegs, each one of {{colors}} colors.
rules.duplicates: A color can appear more than once.
rules.exact: A dark dot: one peg has the right color in the right place.
rules.misplaced: A light dot: one peg has the right color in the wrong place.
rules.order: The dots don't tell you which pegs they mean.

game.confirmQuit: Quit this game? It can't be continued.
